messages:
maya: Quick triage — need to bucket private deploy networking & packaging asks into a launch matrix. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/priv-deploy/launch-matrix (draft). Goal: propose MVP vs Post-MVP1 vs Field-scope by EOD Wed. Thoughts?
igor: +1. Can you call out hard blockers vs nice-to-have? We should separate infra blockers (IP reservation, onprem installer) from UX.
jen: Customer asks from ACME/FinCo: IP preservation, static egress, cert rotation via their KMS. They want airgap install script too. I'll paste snippets.
jen: ```bash
# installer flags
./installer --airgap --static-egress --kms=azure_kv
```
carlos: ACME is deal-moving for us. If MVP doesn't include cert rotation automation, they won't sign. They can accept manual steps for airgap v1.
maya: Ok — proposal: MVP = VPC handshakes + static-egress + simple airgap installer (manual cert apply). Post-MVP1 = automated cert rotation, KMS integrations, tenant isolation. Field = fine-grained routing, IP-per-tenant, per-customer network policies.
igor: Tech constraints: cert rotation requires hooking into our key-operator (not yet packaged for private). ETA for packaging that is ~3 sprints. Also need kube CNI docs for customers.
jen: Suggest splitting by risk/effort matrix: low effort/high impact -> static-egress, install presets. High effort/high impact -> KMS automation. Low impact -> per-tenant IP pools.
maya: +1. Can someone draft launch criteria checklist items? I'll assemble into the doc.
igor: Checklist start:
```text
- Installer can run offline (airgap) with documented manual cert steps
- VPC handshake validates CIDR/prefix collision and warns
- Static egress/NAT docs + test harness
- Rollback plan for upgrade path (0-downtime preferred)
- SLA: 99.5% control-plane uptime for Dedicated customers
```
carlos: Add: Customer acceptance test (CAT) templates for NetOps to run. ACME requires test harness.
jen: Also include: support path (oncall rotation + triage runbook) — add contact matrix.
maya: Great. I'll tentatively mark KMS automation as Post-MVP1 and create two engineering tickets: PKG-1234 (airgap + static-egress) and PKG-1235 (VPC handshake validation).
deploy-bot: CI job triggered: private-packaging-e2e on branch feature/priv-launch-matrix — build queued.
igor: FYI — we need product/legal signoff for IP preservation wording in the SLA. tagging @legal when ready.
maya: tagging @legal in doc. I'll update the matrix by tomorrow. If no objections, we'll surface this at the launch-planning retro.
